title: Join Two Futures
goal: Sequence the dependent async operations so step one feeds into step two.
hints: Look at where x is defined and where it is passed as an argument.
An async result must be awaited before its value can be passed into the next step.
explanation: The pipeline requires step_one to complete first so its result `x` can be passed to step_two. Placing `step_two(x)` before `let x` produces error `E0425` because `x` is not yet defined in scope. Returning `y` before it is computed similarly fails compilation.
